🗳️ US midterms | Democrats swept Congress and AI stocks split in TWO!! Big Tech soared while chips and power crashed 😱🔥

1️⃣ What happened: Democrats won both the House and Senate. The Dow jumped 3.0% (+1,569 pts), its best day since April 2025, but investors fear tighter rules on data centers

2️⃣ Winners: Microsoft +6.7% (~+$259B), Amazon +6.1%, Apple +5.3%, Alphabet +3.2%. CNBC: hurdles to the AI build-out could help the big spenders' cash flows

3️⃣ Losers, chips: Nvidia -3.2% (~-$159B), Micron -7.0%; in Asia, SoftBank and Advantest fell ~8%

4️⃣ Losers, power and AI clouds: Vistra -13.8% after a KeyBanc downgrade, Constellation -6.7%, CoreWeave -9.9%, Tesla -3.3%. Texas governor-elect Hinojosa pledged a moratorium on new data centers; Texas has ~27% of US data center gigawatts (Wells Fargo)

5️⃣ Overdone? RSM's Brusuelas: "It is necessary that the investment in AI slow to a more sustainable pace." BofA's Bhave: a bit of "sand in the gears" could help markets in the medium term

📌 The new Congress takes office in January; no data center law has passed yet.
